previous.title: Sonatina in C major, Op. 36 No. 1 (1st movement, exposition)

outcomeNote: Replaced by the conversion of the whole first movement from mutopia-804 (38 bars, both repeats; 0 differences on every aspect). Until 2026-09-24 the shelf called it the exposition only (bars 1-15) and a hand edit had lowered the tempo to 144; it is now exactly the converter and engraving tool output, tempo 156 from the source MIDI (owner decision, T104).
